description: Source code for user authentication and account management in a Node.js backend, including signup, login, logout, user retrieval, update, password reset, and account activation.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation, password hashing, user creation, email confirmation, and automatic login.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, including validation, password verification, token generation, and setting authentication cookie.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication cookie to log out the user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user details based on authenticated user ID.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user information, including optional password change.

methods.name: getResetToken
methods.description: Generates and sends a password reset token via email.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user password using a valid reset token and logs in the user automatically.

methods.name: activateAccount
methods.description: Activates a user account using an activation token.
